title: How to Test Hot Stamping Foil Before Bulk Orders

seo.title: How to Test Hot Stamping Foil Before Bulk Orders

content:
A color card can show the foil effect, but it cannot prove that the foil will work on your real packaging material. Before ordering hot stamping foil for paper boxes, run a practical sample test on the actual production surface.

## Start With the Real Substrate

Use the same paper board, printed sheet, varnished sheet or laminated paper that will be used in production. If the final package has several surfaces, test each one separately.

## Use the Right Artwork

The test artwork should include small text, thin lines, a logo, reverse text and a solid area. A foil that works on a large logo may not handle small letters. A foil that handles small letters may not cover a large block evenly.

## Check the Result After Stamping

Look at transfer completeness, edge clarity, metallic brightness and background cleanliness. After the sheet cools, check adhesion with tape, rubbing and folding. If the package will go through more finishing steps, include those steps in the test.

## Confirm the Roll Specification

Before placing the order, confirm color code, roll width, roll length, core size, slitting tolerance, packing method, lead time and batch consistency.

## FAQ

### Why is real-material testing important?

Because paper coating, ink, varnish and lamination can change the result.

### What is the most useful test artwork?

A mix of small text, fine lines, solid area and the real logo.
